verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail publishes check-deposit terms. Requests are processed and mailed out within 1 business day, funds usually clear within a week, and express shipping is available. That covers turnaround and implies the physical check is mailed to your bank. Pricing is described as pay-per-deposit with no setup or monthly fees, plus multi-check savings, but no actual per-deposit amount is shown. Missing for 10: list of supported banks, specific per-deposit fee amounts, explicit statement of what happens to the physical check (beyond being mailed), independent corroboration.
